description: 국가철도공단_인천1호선 역간거리 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 인천1호선 역간거리 데이터는 인천교통공사에서 운영하는 인천1호선 노선에 포함된 역들 간 거리 정보를 체계적으로 제공합니다. 주요 역으로는 계양, 귤현, 박촌, 임학, 계산, 경인교대입구, 작전, 갈산, 부평구청, 부평시장, 부평, 동수, 부평삼거리, 간석오거리, 인천시청, 예술회관, 인천터미널, 문학경기... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 기본역사정보, 역간거리, 지하철, 인천지하철역간거리, 인천1호선역간거리. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
